title: The flattened upstream set of one tool (entity)

version.x-decides: whether the file is read or ends not ready on a version newer than the engine reads

tool.x-decides: which tool's bindings the sets are counted under

sets.description: the upstream presets, each with the entry keys it held at the pin

preset.x-decides: which rung-0 binding adopts the set, by its key

sets.x-decides: which upstream presets a rung-0 binding can adopt whole, and the entries each explains

observed.description: every entry key the upstream config holds now
observed.x-decides: which entries coverage counts, and which of them nothing explains
